name: POST /api/voice-agent/trunks/:trunk_id/sync-numbers - Attach newly bound numbers
description: After numbers are bound to agents, attaches every bound Twilio number found in the tenant's account to the trunk and recreates the LiveKit inbound trunk and dispatch rule for them, so calls to the new numbers reach the voice runtime (506bbf30-2d83-440b-a853-1a8205f4b3cb#AC1). Numbers not in the account come back in skipped_numbers. Only an active trunk can sync (409). The API runner has no Twilio account or LiveKit SIP service, so its datasets lead with the deterministic refusals; the provisioning path is exercised against Twilio/LiveKit API stubs that check every request.

errorCases.when: no trunk with that id for the caller's tenant (includes another tenant's trunk)

errorCases.message: only an active trunk can sync numbers
errorCases.when: the trunk is not active or its credential is gone
